verdict: Salesforce grew revenue 9% to $10.3B as Agentforce and Data 360 ARR hit nearly $1.4B — up 114% — and a $263M paper gain on its investments helped lift net income 37% to $2.09B.

segments.name: Subscription and support
segments.note: The core software subscriptions — Sales, Service, Slack, Tableau, Agentforce and Data 360.

segments.name: Professional services and other
segments.note: Consulting and training that help customers roll the software out.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platform — including Agentforce, Salesforce's AI agents, and Data 360 — up 6% YoY.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The largest running cost — Salesforce's big sales force and marketing machine, up 4% YoY.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — down 6% YoY.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: One-off costs of reorganizing teams — up sharply from $56M a year ago.

takeaways.title: Agentforce is scaling
takeaways.text: Agentforce and Data 360 ARR reached nearly $1.4B, up 114% YoY, with more than 9,500 paid Agentforce deals closed — Salesforce's AI agents are becoming a real revenue line, though still small next to $9.7B of subscription revenue.

takeaways.title: Backlog keeps climbing
takeaways.text: Remaining performance obligation — work customers have signed for but not yet paid — rose 12% to $59.5B, with $29.4B of it due within a year. Future revenue is unusually visible.

takeaways.title: A paper gain padded profit
takeaways.text: Gains on strategic investments added $263M before tax. Core operating income was $2.19B, up 16% from a year ago — solid growth even without the gain.

oneTimers: A $263M gain on strategic investments — paper (mark-to-market) gains on stakes Salesforce holds in other companies.
Restructuring charges of $260M — up from $56M a year ago — sit inside operating expenses.
otherDetail: A $263M paper gain on strategic investments (stakes Salesforce holds in other companies), plus $61M of other income, net — mostly interest earned, net of interest on Salesforce's debt.
